L7·N7642unmasked layer
Fires weakly and noisily on segment-boundary tokens — mostly newlines/line-initial markers (`\n`, diff `+`, a capitalized word or numeral starting a new chunk) — and specifically where the following text abruptly switches topic; the same `\n` token gets strongly negative activation when it merely separates continuous, on-topic prose.

L7·N10810unmasked layer
Fires on the head word that completes formulaic "shared/prior knowledge" discourse markers — e.g. "goes without **saying**", "as explained **earlier**", "need not **say** more", "as we all **know** by now", "the litany is **familiar**", "as I wrote in this post**,**" — i.e., the token closing a phrase appealing to what's already known or previously stated.
